name: Noob Army Tycoon ⚔️(New noobs)
desc:
Welcome to Noob Army Tycoon ⚔️

Develop your tycoon, research new noobs and vehicles, send your troops to the front to control the map
Unlock troops from WW1 to the futuristic era, up to 268 troops, to create the ultimate noob army🏆

New update :
- Added 50 noobs 👥
- Added 47 vehicles 🚗
- New quests and added troops quests 📜
- Added more building skins 🎨
- Added mechs 🤖
- and more to see in game 🎮

How to play :
- Unlock workers and researchers to get new troops 🧪
- Send your troops 🎯
- Capture and defend points to earn more income 📈
- Battle against players or form an alliance ⚔️

Previous update :
- Added defense system 🪖
- Added quests📜
- Added gears 💥

Premium users can unlock a free noob worker and a free noob researcher
Private servers are free
